change_scope: Restore permanent three-theme selection, working Sections/Canvas modes on mobile and desktop, and permanent access to profile/needs with edit, recalculate and print journey; no calculation-engine changes.

architecture.server_credentials: Primary and backup Gemini keys are included only in protected server-side api/gemini-secret.php.

limitations: Physical Android/iPhone, Safari, Samsung Internet and Qt WebEngine remain external acceptance targets.
A live external Gemini HTTP 200 is not claimed from the isolated build environment.
Human usability observation remains a release-candidate activity.
Private archives contain protected server credentials and must not be stored in public download directories.
